question: National Rifle Association of India (NRAI) approved amendments to the NRAI Match Book and other technical rules for domestic competitions in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**March 2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Rifle Association of India (NRAI) is the governing body for the sport of shooting in India.
 
• The NRAI Match Book contains detailed rules and regulations for shooting competitions held in India.
 
• Amendments to the NRAI Match Book and other technical rules ensure the standards are up-to-date and in line with international norms.
 
• These amendments were approved for implementation in March 2024, reflecting the NRAI's commitment to maintaining high standards in domestic competitions.
 
• The changes are aimed at improving the quality and fairness of shooting competitions in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Rifle Association of India (NRAI)**

 
 
• Founded in 1951, the NRAI is responsible for promoting the sport of shooting in India.
 
• It is affiliated with the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) and the Asian Shooting Confederation (ASC).
 
• The NRAI organizes national shooting championships and selects athletes for international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Shooting Sports**
 
 
• Shooting sports include various disciplines such as rifle, pistol, and shotgun events.
 
• These events are governed by strict rules to ensure safety and fairness.
 
• Competitions are held at various levels, including state, national, and international events.
 
 
 
• **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)**
 
 
• The ISSF is the global governing body for the sport of shooting.
 
• It sets the rules and regulations for shooting competitions worldwide.
 
• The ISSF organizes world championships and oversees shooting events in the Olympic Games.
 
 
 
• **Technical Rules in Shooting**
 
 
• Technical rules cover aspects such as equipment specifications, scoring methods, and competition formats.
 
• They ensure a level playing field for all competitors.
 
• Periodic updates to these rules are necessary to incorporate advancements in technology and changes in international standards.
